{{short description|2021–22 Richmond Spiders men's basketball}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year= 2021–22 |team= Richmond Spiders |sport= basketball |image= Richmond Spiders text logo.svg |image_size= 200 |conference= Atlantic 10 Conference |division= |short_conf= A-10 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record= 24–13 |conf_record= 10–8 |head_coach=[[Chris Mooney (basketball)|Chris Mooney]] |hc_year= 17th |asst_coach1= Rob Jones |asst_coach2= [[Maurice Joseph]] |asst_coach3= [[Kevin Hovde]] |stadium=[[Robins Center]] |champion= Atlantic 10 [[2022 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions |tourney= [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2021–22 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Richmond]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by 17th-year head coach [[Chris Mooney (basketball)|Chris Mooney]] and played their home games at the [[Robins Center]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 24–13, 10–8 in Atlantic 10 play to finish in sixth place. As the No. 6 seed, they defeated [[2021–22 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]], [[2021–22 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]], [[2021–22 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]], and [[2021–22 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]] to win the [[2022 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|Atlantic 10 tournament]]. They received the conference’s automatic bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 12 seed in the Midwest Region, where they upset [[2021–22 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]] in the First Round before losing to [[2021–22 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] in the Second Round. On December 5, 2021, senior guard [[Jacob Gilyard]] set the new [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball career steals leaders|all-time NCAA Division I career steals]] record, securing his 386th steal to surpass [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]]'s [[John Linehan (basketball)|John Linehan]] (385), whose record had stood since 2002.{{cite news |last=O'Connor |first=John |date=December 5, 2021 |title=Jacob Gilyard sets NCAA career steals record, Tyler Burton scores 26 as Spiders win at Northern Iowa |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/richmond/jacob-gilyard-sets-ncaa-career-steals-record-tyler-burton-scores-26-as-spiders-win-at/article_477e4ba1-93f2-5caa-bce7-f00eb74181d3.html |work=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]] |location=[[Richmond, Virginia]] |access-date=December 5, 2021}} Gilyard ultimately finished his career with a total of 466 steals.{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/jacob-gilyard-1.html |title=Jacob Gilyard college stats |publisher=Sports Reference |website=sports-reference.com |access-date=2022-03-20}} ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Spiders]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 14–9, 6–5 in [[2020–21 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in eighth place. They lost to [[2020–21 Duquesne Dukes men's basketball team|Duquesne]] in the second round of the [[2021 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]].{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401286891 |title=Weathers lifts Duquesne past Richmond 67-62 in A-10 tourney |publisher=Associated Press |date=2021-03-04 |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=2021-08-10}} The Spiders received an at-large bid to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they defeated [[2020–21 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] in the first round{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401311773 |title=Richmond rallies to win opening game of NIT 76-66 |publisher=Associated Press |date=2021-03-17 |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=2021-08-10}} before losing to [[2020–21 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]].{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401311781 |title=Stewart leads Mississippi State over Richmond on late 3 |publisher=Associated Press |date=2021-03-25 |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=2021-08-10}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
